{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import System.Environment (lookupEnv, getArgs)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isInfixOf)
import Network.URI (parseURI, URI(..), URIAuth(..))
import System.Exit (exitFailure, exitSuccess)
import Data.Char (toLower)

-- | Configuration for the redirect service
data RedirectConfig = RedirectConfig
  { allowedDomains :: [String]
  , baseUrl        :: String
  , strictMode     :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Load configuration from environment
loadConfig :: IO RedirectConfig
loadConfig = do
  domains <- lookupEnv "ALLOWED_DOMAINS"
  base <- lookupEnv "BASE_URL"
  strict <- lookupEnv "STRICT_MODE"
  return RedirectConfig
    { allowedDomains = parsedomains (fromMaybe "example.com,myapp.com" domains)
    , baseUrl = fromMaybe "https://myapp.com" base
    , strictMode = parseStrict (fromMaybe "true" strict)
    }

parsedomains :: String -> [String]
parsedomains s = map (map toLower . trim) (splitOn ',' s)

parseStrict :: String -> Bool
parseStrict s = map toLower s `elem` ["true", "1", "yes"]

-- | Split string on delimiter
splitOn :: Char -> String -> [String]
splitOn _ [] = []
splitOn d s = let (first, rest) = break (== d) s
              in first : case rest of
                           [] -> []
                           (_:xs) -> splitOn d xs

trim :: String -> String
trim = reverse . dropWhile (== ' ') . reverse . dropWhile (== ' ')

-- | Validate a redirect URL against the configuration
validateRedirect :: RedirectConfig -> String -> Either String String
validateRedirect config url =
  case parseURI url of
    Nothing -> Left "Invalid URI format"
    Just uri -> validateParsedURI config uri url

-- | Core validation logic for parsed URIs
validateParsedURI :: RedirectConfig -> URI -> String -> Either String String
validateParsedURI config uri originalUrl
  | isRelativePath originalUrl = Right originalUrl
  | otherwise = validateAbsoluteURI config uri originalUrl

-- | Check if a URL is a relative path (safe for redirect)
isRelativePath :: String -> Bool
isRelativePath url = 
  not ("://" `isInfixOf` url) && headSafe url /= Just '\\'

headSafe :: String -> Maybe Char
headSafe [] = Nothing
headSafe (x:_) = Just x

-- | Validate absolute URI against allowed domains
validateAbsoluteURI :: RedirectConfig -> URI -> String -> Either String String
validateAbsoluteURI config uri originalUrl =
  case uriAuthority uri of
    Nothing -> Left "No authority in absolute URI"
    Just auth ->
      let host = map toLower (uriRegName auth)
          normalizedHost = stripWww host
      in if domainAllowed (allowedDomains config) normalizedHost (strictMode config)
         then Right originalUrl
         else Left $ "Domain not allowed: " ++ host

-- | Strip www. prefix for comparison
stripWww :: String -> String
stripWww h
  | "www." `isPrefixOf` h = drop 4 h
  | otherwise = h

-- | Check if domain is in allowed list
-- In strict mode: exact match required
-- In non-strict mode: suffix match (allows subdomains)
domainAllowed :: [String] -> String -> Bool -> Bool
domainAllowed domains host strict
  | strict    = host `elem` domains
  | otherwise = any (\d -> d `isSuffixOfDomain` host) domains

-- | Safe suffix check that respects domain boundaries
-- "evil.com" should NOT match allowed domain "example.com"
-- "sub.example.com" SHOULD match allowed domain "example.com"
isSuffixOfDomain :: String -> String -> Bool
isSuffixOfDomain allowed host
  | allowed == host = True
  | otherwise = ("." ++ allowed) `isSuffixOf'` host

-- | Custom suffix check
isSuffixOf' :: String -> String -> Bool
isSuffixOf' suffix str =
  let lenSuffix = length suffix
      lenStr = length str
  in lenStr >= lenSuffix && drop (lenStr - lenSuffix) str == suffix

-- | Generate the redirect response
generateRedirect :: String -> String
generateRedirect url = "Location: " ++ url ++ "\r\n\r\n"

-- | Main entry point - processes redirect requests
main :: IO ()
main = do
  config <- loadConfig
  args <- getArgs
  case args of
    ["--validate", url] -> do
      case validateRedirect config url of
        Left err -> do
          putStrLn $ "REJECTED: " ++ err
          exitFailure
        Right validUrl -> do
          putStrLn $ "ACCEPTED: " ++ generateRedirect validUrl
          exitSuccess
    ["--redirect", url] -> do
      case validateRedirect config url of
        Left err -> do
          putStrLn $ "Redirect blocked: " ++ err
          putStrLn $ generateRedirect (baseUrl config ++ "/error")
        Right validUrl -> do
          putStrLn $ generateRedirect validUrl
    _ -> do
      putStrLn "Usage: redirect-tool --validate <url>"
      putStrLn "       redirect-tool --redirect <url>"
      putStrLn ""
      putStrLn "Environment variables:"
      putStrLn "  ALLOWED_DOMAINS  Comma-separated list of allowed domains"
      putStrLn "  BASE_URL         Base URL for error redirects"
      putStrLn "  STRICT_MODE      Enable strict domain matching (true/false)"
